title: KR market risk model v1 prospective state receipt
description: One immutable, append-only record per future decision date, written BEFORE the outcome exists. Built and validated by pipeline/kr_market_risk_model_receipts.py. Receipts are evaluated only after their horizon matures on the KR calendar; no historical row is ever rewritten. Prospective evidence is the only route to validation for this model; every historical number is development evidence.

codeIdentity.description: commit SHA plus SHA-256 of every file in the frozen dependency closure that produced the states

signalDate.description: the KR session whose close the states are computed at

executionDate.description: the next KR session; the multiplier applies from its close

createdAtUtc.description: wall-clock time the receipt was written; must precede the execution-session close

inputIdentities.description: SHA-256 of every input snapshot read (reference, VIX, 10y, 3m)

layerInputs.description: the latest known inputs behind each state (close, SMA200, vol63, VIX percentile, sampled spread) for audit; never used to recompute history

candidateMultipliers.description: every candidate is recorded so the prospective record does not depend on the development nomination

finalArchitecture.description: the sealed development nomination; C0 (the control) when none was nominated, including NO_CANDIDATE_NOMINATED_CONTROL_RETAINED and NO_UNAMBIGUOUS_NOMINATION_PARETO_TRADEOFF. All four candidates are recorded in every receipt either way.

nominationSource.description: SHA-256 of the sealed result file the nomination was read from

receiptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of every other field
